entities.summary: Johanna von Schaffgotsch was the adopted daughter of Karl Godulla. She was the first businesswoman in the history of Silesia, as well as one of the richest women in Europe; the combined wealth of von Schaffgotsch and her spouse was estimated to be 79 million marks.
